svg.text: 1 · The page uses the wide width (up to 120 rem of content). At 1280 px the content is 944 px: three zone columns of 304 px. At 1920 px it is 1,584 px: five columns of 304 px. A zone card is never narrower than 18 rem (288
2 · Crew actions are one band above the zones, never a column beside them: one row on a desk (Announce…, Spotlight… and the emergency's hold), first on a phone.

3 · The zones are one auto-fill grid. Two zones keep their card width and leave the rest of the row empty; they are never stretched across the page. Eight zones wrap into rows that end level: every card in a row is as tall as
4 · Storyboards and Scenes are a band of panels under the zones: side by side from 2 × 22 rem, each at most 48 rem wide, one under the other on a phone. Their row ends level too.
5 · Zones keep Screen's order (the order the Screen studio lists them); a zone that starts showing something does not move. Its state is on the card, never in its place.
6 · On a phone: one column, in the page's order: crew actions, the zones, Storyboards, Scenes. Nothing is wider than 358 px.
